brokers.name: AJ Bell
brokers.stock_commission_text: £5.00 per online share deal (£3.50 if you made 10+ share deals in the previous month); regular investing is free
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

brokers.name: AvaTrade
brokers.stock_commission_text: No commission; cost is in the spread (from 0.9 pips on EUR/USD)
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free
brokers.inactivity_text: USD 50 a quarter (EUR 50 / GBP 50, by account currency) after three consecutive months of non-use, and every successive quarter, plus an annual administration fee of USD 100 / EUR 100 / GBP 100 after twelve consecutive months

brokers.name: Capital.com
brokers.stock_commission_text: No commission; cost is in the spread (from 0.6 pips on EUR/USD)
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free

brokers.name: DEGIRO
brokers.stock_commission_text: Commission plus a EUR 1 handling fee per trade: EUR 2 total on US and Canadian exchanges, EUR 4.90 on London and on any European exchange outside your own country, EUR 6 on Australia, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Singapore and Tokyo. ETFs EUR 3, or EUR 1 handling only for the Core Selection (the ETFs listed on Tradegate). Your domestic market is priced separately and the discount is not the same everywhere: Euronext Milan, Bolsa de Madrid and Euronext Paris all cost EUR 2 on their national schedules, Euronext Amsterdam and Brussels EUR 3 on the Dutch one and Euronext Dublin EUR 3 on the Irish one, Nasdaq Stockholm SEK 20 all-in on the Swedish one, while the German schedule gives XETRA no discount at all and charges the full EUR 4.90
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked bank account
brokers.inactivity_text: None (DEGIRO publishes EUR 0 inactivity, custody, deposit and withdrawal fees)

brokers.name: eToro
brokers.stock_commission_text: $1–$2 per side on stock positions (charged on opening and on closing, varies by country of residence); ETFs 0%
brokers.withdrawal_text: $5 per withdrawal on USD accounts ($30 min); free on GBP/EUR accounts
brokers.inactivity_text: None (eToro removed the inactivity fee in 2026)

brokers.name: Fidelity
brokers.stock_commission_text: £7.50 per online share, ETF or investment trust deal (£30.00 by phone); £1.50 for regular savings plan trades and dividend reinvestment; funds free
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

brokers.name: Fortrade
brokers.stock_commission_text: No commission; cost is in the spread (EUR/USD ~2 pips)
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free (some payment methods may charge)
brokers.inactivity_text: USD 10 a month (charged in your account currency) after six consecutive months with no transactions — no deposits, withdrawals or trading activity, including opening a pending order

brokers.name: Freetrade
brokers.stock_commission_text: £0 commission on all UK & US stocks, ETFs and investment trusts (all plans); mutual funds also dealt free with no holding fee since 22 January 2026 (all plans)
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free standard withdrawals; £5 for same-day withdrawal, which is included free on the Plus plan

brokers.name: Hargreaves Lansdown
brokers.stock_commission_text: £6.95 per online share deal (£3.95 if you dealt 20+ times in the previous month); £1.95 per online fund deal; free via monthly direct debit or dividend reinvestment
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

brokers.name: Interactive Brokers
brokers.stock_commission_text: UK shares 0.05% of trade value, minimum £3; European shares 0.05%, minimum €3; US shares from $0.005 per share, minimum $1 (Fixed pricing)
brokers.withdrawal_text: Two free withdrawal requests per calendar month; after that GBP 7.00 by bank transfer or GBP 1.00 by BACS/GIRO (EUR 8.00 / EUR 1.00; USD 10.00 / USD 1.00)
brokers.inactivity_text: None on the standard account (the inactivity fee was removed in 2021)

brokers.name: interactive investor
brokers.stock_commission_text: £3.99 per UK or US share and ETF trade on Core and Plus (£2.99 on Premium); other international shares, including European exchanges, £9.99 on Core, £7.99 on Plus and £5.99 on Premium; funds £3.99 on Core, £1.49 on Plus, free on Premium
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account (next-day GBP and EUR); £15 for a same-day GBP or EUR withdrawal

brokers.name: InvestEngine
brokers.stock_commission_text: £0 dealing commission on all ETFs (DIY portfolios); no platform fee
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free — no withdrawal fee

brokers.name: Lightyear
brokers.stock_commission_text: UK personal accounts (GIA and ISA): no execution fee on UK, US and European stocks or ETFs. EU accounts: GBP 1 per order on UK stocks, EUR 1 per order on EUR-denominated stocks, 0.1% on other European stocks, and 0.10% (min $0.10, max $1) on US stocks. ETFs are execution-fee-free on both.
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free by local bank transfer. USD wire payments are charged (up to $8.50 UK, $6.11 EU).

brokers.name: Pepperstone
brokers.stock_commission_text: Razor: raw spreads plus a fixed commission on FX and Spot Gold (XAU/USD) only — GBP 2.25 per lot per side on a GBP account, USD 3.50 on a USD account, so GBP 4.50 / USD 7 round turn, charged in full when the position opens on MT4 and MT5; cTrader is USD 6 round turn on FX. Standard: no commission on FX, indices or commodities (the cost sits in the spread), but share CFDs cost from 0.1% per side
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free, except bank wire withdrawals to an international bank account, which are charged GBP 15

brokers.name: Plus500
brokers.stock_commission_text: No commission, cost is in the spread
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free — Plus500 charges no deposit or withdrawal fees; your own bank or card issuer may charge on international transfers or unsupported-currency conversions
brokers.inactivity_text: Up to $10/month after 3 months without logging in

brokers.name: Revolut
brokers.stock_commission_text: 1 commission-free order a month on Standard (3 on Plus, 5 on Premium, 10 on Metal and Ultra); beyond the allowance 0.25% of the order amount, or 0.12% on Ultra, minimum GBP 0.01; the Stocks and Shares ISA shares the same allowance and rates
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free

brokers.name: Robinhood
brokers.stock_commission_text: $0 / £0 commission on US stocks and ETFs; options are $0 commission in the US and $0.50 per contract (buys and sells) in the UK; crypto in the US only
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free (bank/ACH); instant withdrawal 1.75% (US); account transfer out $100

brokers.name: Scalable Capital
brokers.stock_commission_text: Price depends on the venue. European Investor Exchange (EIX) — FREE Broker: €0.99 per trade, or €0 on purchases of €250 or more in PRIME ETFs (Amundi, iShares, Vanguard, Xtrackers); PRIME+ Broker (€4.99/mo): €0 per trade from €250, else €0.99. Xetra and gettex: €1.99 flat per order on both plans, PRIME ETFs included, with no free-trade threshold and trading-venue fees waived. EIX is the only venue where the €0.99 and free-above-€250 pricing still applies
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked bank account

brokers.name: Trade Republic
brokers.stock_commission_text: €1 flat per trade (Best Price execution); €2 per order for Direct Price routing to a chosen exchange (Xetra, NYSE, etc., since July 2026)
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked bank account

brokers.name: Trading 212
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free

brokers.name: Vanguard UK
brokers.stock_commission_text: No dealing charge on Vanguard funds and ETFs at the scheduled daily trade; £7.50 for optional live 'quote and deal' ETF trades
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

brokers.name: Webull
brokers.stock_commission_text: $0 on stocks, ETFs and options (regulatory fees on sells). UK: $0 commission on US and Hong Kong / China-A shares and ETFs, on both the free Go tier and Meridian. UK shares are the exception and are not commission-free - Webull markets them as "50p minimum commission", and new accounts get 90 days of commission-free UK trading before the standard rate applies. Webull does not publish the percentage above that 50p floor on its pricing page
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free (ACH); wires $25 to send; account transfer out $75

brokers.name: XTB
brokers.stock_commission_text: 0% up to €100k monthly turnover, then 0.2% (min €10)
brokers.withdrawal_text: Free, with no minimum withdrawal amount - XTB charges no withdrawal commission, including on foreign-currency withdrawals
brokers.inactivity_text: EUR 10/month, only after 365 days with no trade AND no deposit in the previous 90 days. Not charged on ISA accounts, where open positions are held, or on a zero balance.
